# BurFlow

> BurFlow is an AI website sales agent platform: a chat widget that answers visitor questions, qualifies leads, and captures pipeline on your website — deployed in minutes.

- Homepage: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/
- Free tools (50+, no sign-up): https://bur-flow.vercel.app/free-tools
- Pricing: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/pricing
- Live demo: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/demo
- Blog: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/blog

## Key pages

- AI sales agent platform: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/
- AI Chatbot vs AI Sales Agent: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/blog/ai-chatbot-vs-ai-sales-agent
- How to Convert Website Visitors Into Demos: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/blog/how-to-convert-website-visitors-into-demos
- Guide to AI sales agents: https://bur-flow.vercel.app/guides/ai-sales-agents

## Business model

BurFlow is a SaaS platform. Free plan: 100 AI chat messages per month. Paid plans add more messages, advanced analytics, and integrations.
